tax.title: Tax Consulting
tax.whoFor: Foreign-invested companies, holding structures, and cross-border operators navigating Uzbekistan's fiscal complexity.
tax.description: Our tax practice navigates Uzbekistan's evolving fiscal landscape with precision — designing structures that optimise your position while maintaining full regulatory compliance across cross-border transactions, local VAT obligations, and everything in between.

legal.title: Legal Advisory
legal.whoFor: International businesses entering Uzbekistan, M&A counterparties, and companies requiring regulatory clearances.
legal.description: Our legal team provides end-to-end counsel for businesses operating in Uzbekistan — from entity formation and contract architecture to regulatory compliance and corporate structuring — protecting your interests with the rigour that complex, multi-jurisdictional operations demand.

finance.title: Accounting
finance.whoFor: Foreign subsidiaries needing IFRS-compliant reporting, investor-ready financials, or audit-prepared books.
finance.description: We deliver full-cycle financial management — precise bookkeeping, transparent reporting, and strategic advisory that transforms your numbers into actionable intelligence, with full compliance across National Accounting Standards and IFRS.

hr.title: Human Resources
hr.whoFor: Growing businesses requiring compliant HR infrastructure, executive hiring, or workforce compliance reviews.
hr.description: Our HR advisory practice covers the strategic and compliance dimensions of human capital — from organisational design and executive search to HR audits and labour law guidance — advising on the frameworks that underpin a compliant, high-performing workforce in Uzbekistan.

ma-advisory.title: M&A Advisory
ma-advisory.whoFor: Strategic acquirers, PE funds, and founders seeking M&A transactions in Uzbekistan and Central Asia.
ma-advisory.description: Our M&A practice guides buyers and sellers through every stage of a transaction in Uzbekistan — from structuring and due diligence to negotiation and post-deal integration — with a track record spanning $250M+ deals across FMCG, fintech, energy, and manufacturing.

due-diligence.title: Due Diligence
due-diligence.whoFor: Buyers, lenders, and investors requiring independent risk assessment before a transaction closes.
due-diligence.description: Our due diligence practice provides comprehensive tax, legal, and financial assessment of Uzbek targets — giving acquirers, investors, and lenders a clear picture of what they are buying, with 30+ engagements completed across energy, mining, FMCG, and manufacturing.

entity-management.title: Entity Management
entity-management.whoFor: Foreign companies that need a complete operational presence in Uzbekistan without building an in-house management team.
entity-management.description1: For foreign companies that want a full presence in Uzbekistan without building an internal team, we take complete operational control — acting as your on-the-ground management layer across accounting, tax, legal, and HR.
entity-management.description2: One contract, one point of contact, full compliance. Everything your entity needs to operate correctly and efficiently.

corporate.title: Corporate Services
corporate.whoFor: International businesses establishing or maintaining a legal presence in Uzbekistan — from incorporation to ongoing secretarial administration.
corporate.description1: We handle the full lifecycle of your corporate presence in Uzbekistan — from incorporation and ongoing administration to nominal services that let foreign companies operate without a physical footprint.
corporate.description2: Our corporate services team manages the paperwork, deadlines, and compliance so you can focus on your business.

eor.title: Employer of Record
eor.whoFor: International companies that want to hire staff in Uzbekistan immediately, without first incorporating a local entity.
eor.description1: We become the legal employer for your staff in Uzbekistan — handling all employment contracts, payroll, tax withholding, and statutory compliance while your team works entirely for you.
eor.description2: EOR is the fastest way to build a local presence without the cost and complexity of entity formation.
capabilities: Transition to own entity when ready

payroll.title: Payroll Bureau
payroll.whoFor: Companies with Uzbekistan-based employees that need accurate, fully compliant payroll processing every cycle.
payroll.description1: We handle the complete payroll cycle for your Uzbekistan workforce — calculation, withholding, reporting, and payment — with full compliance with local tax and labour law.
payroll.description2: Whether you have 5 or 500 employees, our payroll bureau runs accurately and on time, every month.

immigration.title: Work Permits & Immigration
immigration.whoFor: Foreign nationals relocating to Uzbekistan for work, and the international companies employing them.
immigration.description1: We manage the full cycle of work permit applications, visa support, and immigration compliance for foreign nationals working in Uzbekistan — removing complexity and reducing processing time.
immigration.description2: From initial application to renewal and exit, our team handles every interaction with the relevant authorities on your behalf.

virtual-office.title: Virtual Office
virtual-office.whoFor: Overseas companies exploring the Uzbekistan market, or businesses that need a registered address without committing to physical office space.
virtual-office.description1: Establish a credible Uzbekistan address for your business without committing to physical space. Our virtual office service provides a registered address, mail handling, and access to meeting facilities when you need them.
virtual-office.description2: Ideal for companies exploring the market, managing compliance obligations, or running a lean local presence.

compliance.title: Compliance Monitoring
compliance.whoFor: Entities that need continuous assurance their Uzbekistan operations are meeting every regulatory, tax, and filing obligation.
compliance.description1: Uzbekistan's regulatory environment evolves rapidly. Our compliance monitoring service tracks filing deadlines, legislative changes, and reporting obligations across tax, legal, and corporate — keeping your entity permanently in good standing.
compliance.description2: We operate as your regulatory early-warning system, flagging what matters before it becomes a problem.
